Voter Information (Yancey County, NC)
The Yancey County Board of Elections conducts municipal, county, state, and federal elections in compliance with North Carolina election law and under the supervision of the N.C. State Board of Elections.
Follow us on
Facebook
for official updates and election information.
Upcoming Election
The next statewide general election is
Tuesday, November 3, 2026
. Absentee ballots begin mailing to eligible voters who requested one on
September 4, 2026
. In-person early voting runs from
October 15 through October 31, 2026
.
Official Notice of Yancey County General Election 2026 (PDF)
Contests on the ballot include U.S. Senate, U.S. House, N.C. Supreme Court Associate Justice, N.C. Court of Appeals, Superior and District Court judges, N.C. Senate and House, Clerk of Superior Court, Sheriff, County Commissioners, Board of Education, Soil and Water Conservation District, and a statewide referendum proposing amendments to the N.C. Constitution.
2026 General Election Early Voting
In-person early voting for the 2026 General Election will be held from
Thursday, October 15 through Saturday, October 31, 2026
.
Early Voting Location:
Yancey County Board of Elections
30 East U.S. Highway 19-E Bypass
Burnsville, NC 28714

Eligible individuals who are not registered to vote by the regular voter registration deadline may register and vote at the early voting site during the early voting period. This is known as
same-day registration
.
Learn more about same-day registration
.
Learn more about in-person early voting in North Carolina
.
2026 General Election Dates & Deadlines
September 4, 2026:
Absentee ballots begin mailing to eligible voters who requested one.
October 9, 2026 (5:00 p.m.):
Voter registration deadline.
October 15, 2026:
In-person early voting begins; same-day registration is available during the early voting period.
October 20, 2026 (5:00 p.m.):
Absentee ballot request deadline.
October 31, 2026 (3:00 p.m.):
In-person early voting ends.
November 3, 2026:
Election Day.
November 3, 2026 (7:30 p.m.):
Absentee ballot return deadline.
Note:
Voter registration and absentee voting deadlines are different for military and overseas citizen voters.

Where Do I Vote?
Use the official
Voter Search
tool to find your polling place, election districts, and sample ballot when available.
Register to Vote / Update Your Registration
Need to register, update your name or address, or change party affiliation? Start here:
Checking & Managing Your Registration (NCSBE)
.
Ways to Vote
Early Voting:
In-person early voting for the 2026 General Election is available October 15 through October 31 at the Yancey County Board of Elections office. Same-day registration is available to eligible individuals during the early voting period.
View early voting dates and hours
.
Election Day:
On Election Day, registered voters must vote at their assigned polling place. Polls are open from
6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m.
Election Day info (NCSBE)
.
Vote by Mail (Absentee):
Any registered North Carolina voter may request, receive, and vote a mail-in absentee ballot. No excuse is needed.
Vote by Mail info (NCSBE)
.
Curbside Voting:
Curbside voting is available for voters who are unable to enter the voting place without physical assistance.
If You Have an Issue at the Polls:
If there is a problem with your eligibility, registration, or required ID, you may be offered a provisional ballot and receive instructions for next steps.
Voter Photo ID
Voters will be asked to show photo ID when voting in North Carolina. All voters will be allowed to vote with or without a photo ID. Review acceptable IDs and learn about ID exceptions and requirements:
Voter ID Information (NCSBE)
.
North Carolina registered voters who do not have an acceptable photo ID for voting may obtain a
free voter photo ID
from the Yancey County Board of Elections office.

Meeting Location:

30 East U.S. Highway 19-E Bypass, Suite 2
Burnsville, NC 28714
All Board of Elections meetings are open to the public.
